model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the relationship between a value labeled “γ” and “Trajectory length” for different categories. The x-axis is labeled “γ”, has a linear scale ranging from 0.86 to 1.00, and tick labels are displayed at intervals of 0.02. The y-axis is labeled “Trajectory length”, has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 22, and tick labels are displayed at intervals of 2.  A red dashed line representing “Unsuccessful” starts at approximately 15.2 with γ = 0.86 and increases to approximately 21.2 with γ = 1.00, with error bars demonstrating variance at each γ value; the error bar at γ=1.00 extends from about 19.5 to 22.7. A blue dashed line representing “All” begins at approximately 14.8 with γ = 0.86 and rises to approximately 17.5 with γ = 1.00, also with error bars, where those at γ=1.00 extend from about 16.0 to 19.0. Finally, a green dashed line representing “Successful” starts at approximately 10.3 with γ = 0.86 and increases to approximately 14.6 with γ = 1.00, again with error bars; the error bar at γ=1.00 extends from about 13.0 to 16.0.
